description: Use when benchmarking payer performance, building a denial management strategy, or preparing revenue cycle board reporting. Returns denial rates by payer, prior authorization burden by specialty, and payer mix commentary. Example: Commercial payer denial rates — UnitedHealth 8.2%, Cigna 9.4%, Aetna 7.1% — prior auth burden 34% higher for specialist services — top quartile denial rate is 5.1%. Source: Stratalize national revenue cycle composite. $0.10 USDC per call.
